objections.about: The customer asked which number is the real one to put in a sponsor report this week. The reply never says which figure to use or how the two relate for that purpose. It also doesn't say whether Blotato is missing views, or that the figure will keep rising.

The section says a second delay stacks on YouTube's validation delay. Blotato returns the latest snapshot it collected, not a live figure. The reply leaves this out and explains the gap only through YouTube validation. That matters for someone about to publish a figure this week, and it makes step 5's claim that Studio Analytics matches Blotato look more exact than it is.
